home.title: Engineer, builder, *problem-solver*
summary: I design and build production web applications from database architecture to smooth, accessible user interfaces.
With expertise spanning Java, Spring Boot, React, and Next.js, I focus on dependable systems that ship reliably on time.
Whether designing resilient microservices or optimizing core web vitals, I write clean, maintainable code built for scale.

bio: I am a full-stack engineer who loves building clean, resilient web software that creates genuine business value.

My technical journey began with foundational computer science principles and deep exploration of object-oriented architecture in Java. Over the past several years, I have architected high-throughput Spring Boot microservices, designed normalized relational databases in MySQL and PostgreSQL, and built intuitive frontends with React and Next.js.
I believe that great software balances technical rigor with pragmatic execution. Every abstraction must earn its place, and performance is a feature that should be measured from day one.
When I'm not writing code or analyzing query execution plans, I contribute to developer communities, read technical whitepapers, and experiment with modern web motion and typography.
